info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Refunds-v4-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API provides a streamlined way to access information about refunds associated with food delivery services. It enables users to retrieve detailed data on all delivery refunds processed, thus facilitating oversight and analysis. Typical consumers of this API include businesses seeking to manage their financial records and enhance customer service by resolving refund inquiries efficiently. The API is essential for analytics and reporting purposes within the food delivery sector.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of refunds for deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all refunds related to deliveries. It provides detailed information about each refund, including status and related delivery data. Use this to track and manage delivery refunds efficiently.
